Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: SEOUL, SOUTH KOREA Apple today previewed Apple Hongdae, the seventh retail store in South Korea and the 100th Apple Store location in the Asia-Pacific region. Apple Hongdae has nearly 100 expert retail team members ready to help customers explore and get their hands on the latest Apple products, including the latest iPhone 15 lineup; the new Mac lineup with the M3 family of chips; the Apple Watch lineup, featuring Apple’s first-ever carbon neutral products; as well as the Lunar New Year special-edition AirPods Pro debuting in South Korea and celebrating the Year of the Blue Dragon. Starting February 12, the session will be available across stores in all of South Korea, Japan, and Australia as part of the Bring on College with Apple campaign. Apple opened its first store in South Korea, Apple Garosugil, in 2018. The team at Apple Hongdae will welcome its first customers on Saturday, January 20, at 10 a.m.
